description: Design a database schema from a natural language description. Generates CREATE TABLE SQL (PostgreSQL), index recommendations, and a text-based ERD. Optionally accepts explicit table definitions to validate and enhance.

description.description: Natural language description of the data model (e.g. 'an e-commerce platform with products, orders, and user reviews')

tables.description: Optional: provide explicit table definitions to validate and enhance instead of generating from description

nullable.description: Whether the column allows NULL values

primary.description: Whether this column is a primary key

type.description: SQL column type (e.g. VARCHAR(255), INTEGER, TIMESTAMPTZ)

unique.description: Whether this column has a UNIQUE constraint

name: design_schema
